audio.prompt: Instrumental looping game soundtrack for Pixel Tank Battle. Pixel arcade tank battle game. Top-down view. Player controls GREEN tank: WASD movement, mouse for aiming, spacebar to shoot. Enemies: light tank (fast, 1 hit), medium tank (slow, 3 hits, shoots back), heavy tank (very slow, 5 hits, powerful shot). Map: destructible brick walls, indestructible metal blocks, bushes for hiding. Powerups: star (rapid fire), helmet (shield 5sec), bomb (all enemies). Waves increase. Pixel explosions on enemy death. All canvas-drawn pixel blocks: tanks 32x32, walls 16x16. HUD: lives top left, score center, wave right. Music from menu. ESC pause with menu button. Russian UI.. Theme retro. Energetic, polished, suitable for browser arcade gameplay, no vocals.
